tokenize_java_code: tokenize Java source code into a stream of typed tokens using the JavaTokenizer class
reformat_java_tokens: reformat a list of Java tokens into a pretty-printed string with proper indentation
create_java_token: create a JavaToken instance with a value, position, and optional javadoc comment
detect_java_keywords: detect Java keywords, modifiers, basic types, and literals from tokenized source code
handle_java_unicode_escapes: decode Java unicode escape sequences and preprocess source data before tokenization
